new_clues.title: Parser grammar is runtime-profile-aware
new_clues.implication_for_a: Bind SSF token/control meaning to parser state/profile before semantic promotion.

new_clues.title: F8 performs runtime dynamic source injection in PSF
new_clues.implication_for_a: Search for dynamic source switching and re-entry into the normal SSF render path.

new_clues.title: FE reaches the GPU upload path
new_clues.implication_for_a: Trace control consequence through renderer and video-memory transfer, not call adjacency only.

new_clues.title: FF terminator is a handler return contract
new_clues.implication_for_a: Distinguish parser exit semantics from offline byte-boundary parsing.

new_clues.title: Runtime source pointers can be rebound to persistent file offsets
new_clues.implication_for_a: Define SSF stable IDs with resource, file range, owner, runtime consumer and evidence class.

new_clues.title: Persistent and ephemeral runtime text need separate IDs
new_clues.implication_for_a: Do not force dynamically generated SSF text into disk-record identity models.

new_clues.title: BMESS0 supports owner-aware structural variable-length repack
new_clues.implication_for_a: Prove each SSF resource owner/container separately before variable-length relocation.

new_clues.title: Cross-platform inheritance unit is semantic event, not opcode number
new_clues.implication_for_a: Use PSF as semantic/method reference only; never inherit PS implementation numbers into Saturn.
